🎬 Faith Under Fire (2020)

Faith Under Fire follows Tom Hatcher, a dedicated firefighter whose life becomes overwhelmed by tragedy, grief, and a growing crisis of faith. After experiencing devastating personal losses, Tom struggles to find meaning in a world that seems determined to take away everything he loves. Although he spends his career risking his life to rescue others, he finds himself unable to escape the emotional pain and loneliness consuming his own life. As his relationship with his daughter becomes increasingly strained, Tom begins questioning the beliefs that once gave him strength and purpose. His journey takes an unexpected turn when he encounters people who recognize his suffering and offer compassion, encouragement, and spiritual guidance. Through difficult conversations, moments of vulnerability, and unexpected acts of kindness, Tom gradually begins confronting the anger and heartbreak he has carried for so long. As he searches for a reason to keep moving forward, he discovers that healing does not mean forgetting the past but learning to find hope despite life’s greatest challenges. Combining emotional performances, heartfelt storytelling, and an uplifting message, Faith Under Fire explores grief, family, forgiveness, resilience, redemption, and the extraordinary power of faith during life’s darkest moments.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Faith • Family

⭐ IMDb: 4.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 28m • Not Rated

🎥 Director: Joel Paul Reisig
